title: Carrier
description: One carrier folder's carrier.json: the single source of truth for that carrier. scripts/generate-api-contract.mjs merges every carriers/*/carrier.json into contracts/openapi.json under x-carriers and regenerates the TypeScript, Swift and package catalogs from it.

id.description: Carrier id; must equal the folder name and appears in CarrierId.

displayNames.description: Localized names, keyed by locale. Only carriers whose name is translated define this.

aliases.description: Other names the carrier is known by. Reserved for a later enrichment phase.

region.description: Where the carrier operates. Reserved for a later enrichment phase.

brand.description: The carrier's visual identity. Only brand.color reaches the published contract; packages/carriers/core/brand renders the rest.

color.description: Accent color used by the web and native clients.

family.description: The identity this carrier belongs to, when several carrier ids share one (the GLS country folders all declare "gls"). Defaults to the carrier id. Exactly one member of a family declares the brand.palette and brand.decal the whole family wears; the others only declare the family.

palette.description: Explicit values for an approved wordmark, overriding what brand.color would derive. Every property is optional: declare only the ones the wordmark requires and let the rest follow from brand.color.

decal.description: Livery painted on the truck mark. Omitted means "default".

selectable.description: Whether the carrier appears in the manual carrier picker.

timezone.description: IANA timezone used when the carrier reports local timestamps without an offset.

mode.description: automatic: we fetch tracking ourselves. link-only: we can only link to the portal.

adapter.description: "universal", the id of a carrier folder that has adapter.ts (its own, or the folder whose adapter serves it), or null for link-only carriers.

upstreamName.description: Carrier name as the serving adapter's upstream service spells it, when it differs from displayName.

requirements.description: Extra inputs the user must supply besides the tracking number.

steps.description: Ordered runner steps. Reserved for the runner phase; empty means the adapter still owns its own flow.

capabilities.description: Declared capability flags. Reserved for a later phase.

portal.description: Facts about the carrier's public tracking portal.

siteName.description: Name of the site the portal URL points at, when it is not the carrier itself.

canaryUrl.description: Public, credential-free HTTPS URL the daily canary probes. Required for automatic carriers.

shows.description: Fields the portal displays. Reserved for a later documentation phase.

scraped.description: Fields we retain. Reserved for a later documentation phase.

discarded.description: Fields the portal shows that we deliberately drop. Reserved for a later documentation phase.

unavailable.description: Fields the portal does not expose. Reserved for a later documentation phase.

links.description: Rules that recognize a carrier tracking link pasted by the user.

detection.description: Rules that recognize a tracking number. Exactly one high-confidence match selects the carrier.

field.description: Input name; the generator checks it against the validators it accepts.

whenTrackingNumber.description: Regular expression: the input is only required for matching tracking numbers.

id.description: Stable rule id, unique across the catalog; the sweep and the collision file refer to it.
